object: oriented Zr-MOF membranes for helium separation
problem: How to fabricate {001}-oriented MOF membranes that achieve precise He/CH4 separation with high permeance and robustness?
mechanism_or_method: Metal-organic polyhedra fragments act as metallocene anchors inducing c-axis oriented growth of Zr-MOF, raising CH4 transition energy barrier.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; scalability and performance with real natural gas feeds not established.

object: electrochemical CO2 capture reactor with porous solid electrolyte
problem: Can a modular electrochemical reactor continuously capture CO2 from air and flue gas with long-term stability?
mechanism_or_method: Porous solid electrolyte reactor using OER/ORR with sodium bicarbonate as cyclic mediator in a recirculation mode regenerating pure CO2.
limitation: Bench-scale reactor tested about 2000 hours; energy consumption and scale-up costs not detailed in abstract.

problem: How to dissipate condensation heat to raise solar freshwater production efficiency?
mechanism_or_method: Latent heat-assisted evaporative cooling using delignified wood substrate to remove condensation heat and speed vapor diffusion.
limitation: Lab demonstration under controlled illumination; outdoor performance not reported.
decision_relevance: Guides condenser design in passive solar stills.

object: hindered urea bond polyurethane thermoset networks
problem: How can crosslinked thermosets be decrosslinked and upcycled without performance loss on recycling?
mechanism_or_method: Dynamic polyurethane with hindered urea bonds undergoing amine-triggered exchange to give reprocessable thermoplastics used in composites and shielding.
limitation: Lab-synthesized small samples; long-term recycling cycles and cost at scale not shown.

problem: Can one learning controller adapt across diverse soft arms, tasks and perturbations with stability guarantees?
mechanism_or_method: Neuron-inspired offline structural and online plastic synapses with error-gated updates and a learned contraction metric as stability constraint.
limitation: Validated on two arm types in laboratory; unstructured real-world deployment untested.
decision_relevance: Supports adaptive control choice for soft manipulators under payload and actuator faults.

problem: Can mechanochemical treatment with CO2 recover lithium and upgrade transition metals in one process?
mechanism_or_method: Mechanochemical micro-segregation creates Li-rich surface; CO2 leaching forms lithium bicarbonate; residual metals become OER catalysts.
limitation: Lab-scale batches; scalability and economics not demonstrated in abstract.

problem: How to assemble macrocycles into loose interconnected membranes for dye/salt separation in high-salinity wastewater?
mechanism_or_method: Unidirectional diffusion assisted interfacial polymerization positioning tetra-aldehyde calixarene at the organic boundary on a hydrogel surface.
limitation: Lab-scale films; fouling and long-term operation with real wastewater limited.

problem: Can transient entanglements resolve the strength-toughness trade-off in single-covalent-network hydrogels?
mechanism_or_method: Networks with abundant dangling chains forming transient entanglements that slip and disentangle on loading, dissipating energy and homogenizing stress.
limitation: Mechanism inferred from mechanical tests; only polyacrylamide chemistry shown.
decision_relevance: Suggests simpler tough-hydrogel designs for wear-resistant soft devices.

problem: How to enhance elastocaloric entropy change in polymers for solid-state cooling?
mechanism_or_method: Inorganic nanofillers shear interlaminar chains, aggregating effective elastic chains and adding entropy contribution; large-deformation cooling prototype demonstrated.
limitation: Prototype-level cooling system; fatigue life and device scaling not reported.
decision_relevance: Informs material selection for elastocaloric refrigeration prototypes.

problem: How to make adhesives with high strength and toughness that retain performance at elevated temperature?
mechanism_or_method: Solution shearing forms ordered nanocrystals and aligned nanofibrils in bulk and hydrogen-bonded nanocrystals at the interface.
limitation: Lab lap-shear tests on metal and glass; long-term aging and humidity durability not shown.
decision_relevance: Could replace commercial structural adhesives in load-bearing joints up to 120 C.

problem: How to predict mixture self- and mutual diffusion coefficients with thermodynamically consistent entropy scaling?
mechanism_or_method: Entropy scaling framework using pure-component self-diffusion and infinite-dilution data with mixture entropy from molecular-based equations of state.
limitation: Requires pure-component and infinite-dilution inputs and a good equation of state.
decision_relevance: Improves transport property estimates for process design of fluid mixtures.

problem: What energy loss mechanisms limit a one-port SAW resonator?
mechanism_or_method: Stroboscopic full-field diffraction x-ray microscopy mapping spatiotemporal strain, with wave decomposition to extract device parameters.
limitation: Needs synchrotron x-ray facility; demonstrated on one prototypical resonator design.
decision_relevance: Guides SAW electrode and reflector design to reduce end and side leakage.

object: artificial water channel polyamide desalination membranes
problem: How to incorporate artificial water channels into defect-free polyamide membranes for brackish water desalination?
mechanism_or_method: Self-assembling imidazolylethyl-ureidoethyl-phenyl channels dispersed as colloids with SDS and embedded in polyamide layer during interfacial polymerization.
limitation: Lab-scale coupons; industrial scale claim not demonstrated; fouling and durability unclear.

object: biocrude upgrading catalysts for sustainable aviation fuel
problem: Can zeolite-supported Fe-Mo carbide nanocatalysts upgrade food-waste biocrude into jet-fuel-compliant SAF precursors?
mechanism_or_method: Hydrodeoxygenation of hydrothermal liquefaction biocrude over zeolite-supported molybdenum carbide nanocatalysts, with ASTM tier alpha and beta screening.
limitation: Only prescreening tiers passed; full ASTM certification and continuous operation not shown.

object: enamel-inspired ceramic coatings on metal foils
problem: How to raise stiffness-damping balance and corrosion resistance of metals without increasing density?
mechanism_or_method: Hydrothermal growth of vertically oriented ZrO2 nanorods with amorphous ZrO2 intergranular phase on Zr foil, extendable to Ti, Zn, Cu.
limitation: Thin foil coatings tested in lab; adhesion durability and large-part processing not addressed.

problem: Unclear from abstract; apparently how to reconcile hyperelasticity with adhesiveness via mechanical heterogeneities.
mechanism_or_method: In situ constructed mechanical heterogeneities; adhesion energy-thickness relation is nonlinear below a transition thickness.
limitation: Abstract truncated; evidence and scope unclear.

problem: How to generate multiple acoustic vortices with independent dynamic remote control?
mechanism_or_method: Metasurface encoding multiple topological charges whose features determine vortex singularities, tuned independently to move vortices.
limitation: Demonstrated in air-borne laboratory setups; practical acoustofluidic use not shown.

object: starfish-inspired hydrogel tube feet for underwater adhesion
problem: How to achieve temporary, switchable underwater adhesion for robotic manipulation?
mechanism_or_method: Serially bonded hydrogel mouth and rigid stem; swelling forms cupped pad, vacuum on detachment, pneumatic release.
limitation: Demonstrated on rocks in lab; swelling-time response and cyclic durability limited.

object: power outages from natural disasters in China
problem: Do natural disasters cause unequal power outage impacts in poverty versus non-poverty counties, and how will climate change affect this?
mechanism_or_method: Empirical panel analysis of point-level outage and disaster data 2019-2021 plus SSP-RCP long-term projections.
limitation: Only three years of data; outage dataset access may be restricted; projection assumptions uncertain.
decision_relevance: Targets grid resilience investment toward poverty counties.

object: 3D shrinking electronics from liquid metal on heat-shrinkable polymer
problem: How to fabricate conformal 3D electronics on freeform surfaces simply and at scale?
mechanism_or_method: Print liquid metal patterns on heat-shrinkable substrates; thermal actuation transforms 2D circuits into target 3D geometries.
limitation: Lab demonstrations of antenna and gesture interface; durability and reliability not reported.

problem: How to obtain macroscopic tensile plasticity with strain hardening in metallic glass?
mechanism_or_method: Non-affine thermal strain promotes chemical-fluctuation network of Fe-rich medium-range order, with stress-induced nanocrystallization turning softening into hardening.
limitation: Single Fe-based composition; small specimens and reproducibility across alloys uncertain.

object: soft magnetic microrobots with integrated antennas
problem: How can shape-reconfigurable microrobots communicate their state remotely?
mechanism_or_method: Photolithographed three-layer microrobot of thermoresponsive magnetic hydrogel, anisotropic support and flexible dipole antenna whose shape change is read by radio receivers.
limitation: Proof of concept in lab; in vivo or in-liquid signal range and robustness untested.

problem: How to rapidly prepare large-area, high-crystallinity COF membranes?
mechanism_or_method: Reverse-phase microemulsion interfacial polymerization with ionic liquid network pre-arranging monomers and encapsulating water byproducts, plus scraping-assisted coating.
limitation: Tested on protein desalination over six cycles; long-term stability and cost unclear.

object: grain boundary segregation in Fe-W alloy
problem: How do secondary grain boundary dislocations alter solute segregation energy spectra?
mechanism_or_method: Nanoscale correlative tomography combining crystallography and atom probe chemical analysis to quantify segregation energies at dislocation arrays.
limitation: Single model Fe-W alloy; generalization to other systems not shown.

problem: How to combine strong magneto-responsiveness with hyperelasticity and self-healing in soft materials?
mechanism_or_method: Magnetic ionic liquid [Emim][FeCl4] confined in a urethane polymer through hydrogen and metal-coordination bonds at 80 wt% loading.
limitation: Modest magnetization (2.6 emu/g); long-term ionic liquid leakage and stability unreported.

problem: How to create high-performance entangled hydrogels with long polymer chains compatible with additive manufacturing?
mechanism_or_method: Co-initiating thermal-light dual-initiation producing high-molecular-weight chains and rapid multinetwork formation.
limitation: Lab-scale hydrogels; sensing applications only demonstrated qualitatively.

object: resilient hydrogels with hierarchical sequentially swollen networks
problem: How to build synthetic hydrogels that store and release mechanical energy with low dissipation?
mechanism_or_method: Sequential swelling and photopolymerization steps create hierarchical networks with stretched chains, tuning resilience versus dissipation.
limitation: Lab tests of mechanical cycling only; speed of energy release and long-term fatigue unclear.

object: triazolate MOF [Mn(ta)2] for hydrogen isotope separation
problem: How do isotopologue-induced structural dynamics enable D2/H2 separation in a triazolate MOF?
mechanism_or_method: In situ neutron powder diffraction and cryogenic thermal desorption spectroscopy reveal lattice expansion and site occupancy differences.
limitation: Operates only at cryogenic 60 K; neutron facility needed; industrial upscaling speculative.

object: 3D network materials assembled by tensile buckling
problem: How to assemble 3D architected network materials with regular microstructures and tailorable J-shaped stress-strain response?
mechanism_or_method: Tensile buckling of stacked multilayer 2D precursors with data-driven topology optimization maximizing out-of-plane dimension.
limitation: Lab-scale precursors; biointegration and long-term mechanical reliability not demonstrated.

problem: Can designed complex concentrated alloys combine ultrahigh yield strength with high tensile ductility?
mechanism_or_method: Intelligent alloy design of complex concentrated alloys; details not given in the abstract.
limitation: Abstract gives no detail on composition, processing or scalability.

problem: How to achieve large programmable shape changes at low magnetic fields without continuous field?
mechanism_or_method: Hemispherical bistable shell embedded with magnetic microparticles switched by low-intensity pulsed magnetic torques below 20 mT.
limitation: Demonstrated on lab prototypes; reliability over many switching cycles not stated.
decision_relevance: Informs low-power bistable actuator design for pumps and grippers.

object: living liquid crystals with bacterial traveling waves
problem: How to control traveling waves in living liquid crystals and what breaks parity-time symmetry?
mechanism_or_method: Predefined patterned director fields guide bacterial waves; theory shows wave-induced director reorientation and symmetry breaking drive double waves.
limitation: Living bacterial system specific; applicability to engineered micromachines remains prospective.

object: stick-slip nanopositioner for atomic force microscopy
problem: Can a stick-slip nanopositioner give both high bandwidth and millimeter range for AFM scanning?
mechanism_or_method: Triple-phase controller using displacement accumulation in stepping mode to combine nano-precision scanning with a 3 mm by 3 mm range.
limitation: Bandwidth limited to about 363 Hz; line rate 40 Hz; single custom instrument.
decision_relevance: Supports choosing stick-slip stages for large-area high-speed AFM.

problem: How to make hydrogels with very high strength and tear resistance?
mechanism_or_method: Freeze-assisted bidirectional ion migration producing dense-porous-dense sandwich structure around a mineralized physical crosslinking center.
limitation: Lab-scale samples; long-term stability in wet harsh environments not detailed.

problem: How to extend contact-electro-catalysis to high temperatures using oxides?
mechanism_or_method: Grafting fluorinated functional groups onto SiO2, Al2O3, ZrO2, MgO to enhance contact electrification and electron transfer, applied to battery cathode leaching.
limitation: Lab-scale leaching; mechanical agitation energy cost and scale-up unclear.

problem: How to achieve ultra-low-frequency broadband vibration absorption at deep-subwavelength scale without stiffness loss?
mechanism_or_method: Power-law density-tailored composite (rho-ABH) compressing wavelength and amplifying energy density instead of thickness engineering.
limitation: Laboratory-scale specimens; integration into real structures and environmental durability not shown.
decision_relevance: Enables low-frequency vibration absorbers without thickness tapering.

object: spent LiCoO2 upcycled to Li6CoO4 lithium-replenishing additive
problem: Can flash Joule heating convert spent LiCoO2 into a stable sacrificial lithium source for batteries?
mechanism_or_method: 10-second flash Joule heating forms Li6CoO4, stabilized by sulfur coating that redirects oxygen release into sulfate.
limitation: Pouch cell tests at low current density; life-cycle analysis based on lab-scale assumptions.

problem: How to improve water and thermal management of wood-based solar evaporators with salt resistance?
mechanism_or_method: Partially retain lignin to create intermediate water; laser-graphitize extracted lignin into broadband photothermal layer.
limitation: Indoor one-sun tests; outdoor long-term field operation not reported.

object: soft robot skin pneumatic actuator sheets
problem: How to build thin soft sheet actuators producing multi-directional surface motion vector fields?
mechanism_or_method: Novel multilayer additive process forming dozens of thin pneumatic chambers and multi-channel circuits in a thin soft body.
limitation: Requires external pneumatic supply and valves; performance in real pipes and payloads only demonstrated qualitatively.

object: compact total artificial heart with soft fluidic transmission
problem: Can a soft fluidic transmission enable a compact, efficient total artificial heart?
mechanism_or_method: LIMO concept using thin-walled pouch actuators with transmission ratio above one via circumferential shrinkage in a soft ventricle.
limitation: In vitro single ventricle prototype only; no biventricular system, durability or in vivo testing.

problem: What mechanisms underlie electrostatic enhancement of evaporative cooling?
mechanism_or_method: Experiments show ionic wind and reduced vaporization enthalpy near corona onset voltage, corroborated by Raman spectroscopy.
limitation: Bench experiments; high-voltage safety and ozone generation not discussed; scaling to real coolers unclear.
decision_relevance: May justify electrostatic augmentation in passive evaporative coolers.

object: polyamide nanofiltration membranes by interfacial polymerization
problem: How does backflow H+ during interfacial polymerization control membrane spatial charge?
mechanism_or_method: HCl byproduct backflow associates with piperazine amines, promoting chain termination and positive moieties for Li+/Mg2+ selectivity.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; long-term stability with real brines unclear.

problem: What factors control molten deposit corrosion resistance of multi-rare-earth phosphates?
mechanism_or_method: Stepwise stoichiometric compositional design with up to 15 rare earths, correlating complexity, ionic radius and phase state with corrosion kinetics.
limitation: Laboratory corrosion tests with model deposits; true engine conditions not reproduced.
decision_relevance: Guides composition selection for environmental barrier coatings.

problem: Can hierarchical heterogeneous microstructures give a strong and ductile precious-metal alloy for electronic packaging?
mechanism_or_method: Vacuum suspension melting and heat treatment yield micron phase separation, nano L12 ordering and chemical short-range order.
limitation: Gold-containing alloy cost; fatigue and electrical performance in packaging not reported.

problem: How to conceal or display infrared signatures actively across wide temperature ranges with fast response?
mechanism_or_method: Pixelated thermoelectric panel with optimized circuit, low-reflectivity black porous EVA film, bottom heat dissipation and kirigami bendability.
limitation: Power consumption and field camouflage performance under real surveillance not evaluated.

problem: How to give soft grippers high output force while handling fragile objects delicately?
mechanism_or_method: Rigid tubular bones, flexible joint springs and soft silicone skin with a pneumatic membrane actuator between bones and skin.
limitation: Demonstrated grasps in lab; cycle life and closed-loop control not reported.

object: copolyimide-derived carbon membranes for CO2 separation
problem: How to design carbon membranes with ultrafast, subangstrom-selective CO2 separation?
mechanism_or_method: Controlled carbonization at 800 C of rigid asymmetric copolyimide yields bimodal micropore matrix; adsorption plus molecular sieving, studied by MD and TGA-MS.
limitation: Lab membranes; plasticization, aging and mixed-gas performance under humid flue gas unclear.

problem: What primary supply configurations and recycling make US battery cathode material production cost-effective?
mechanism_or_method: Facility-level regional cost model over 80+ mines and plants, 392 supply configurations, plus techno-economic modelling of two US recycling facilities.
limitation: Depends on assumed prices and facility data; recycling facility primary data may be proprietary.
decision_relevance: Informs sourcing and recycling investment for US cathode supply chains.

problem: Can coupling moisture and temperature gradients raise ionic thermoelectric output?
mechanism_or_method: Device driven by coupled heat and moisture transfer producing fast selective ion transport, with thermopower 34 mV/K.
limitation: Output depends on humidity conditions; stability and continuous operation not described.

problem: Can a single physisorbent remove multiple C3 impurities in one step to yield pure propylene?
mechanism_or_method: ZU-921 to ZU-924 frameworks with aromatic surfaces and fluorine/oxygen electronegative sites tuned by ligand engineering.
limitation: Laboratory column breakthrough scale; cost of ligands and long-term cycling not given.

problem: How does muscle activation length affect fish swimming performance across four gaits?
mechanism_or_method: Vacuum-driven layer jamming muscles in tensegrity joints tune body stiffness to switch gaits, with fluid simulations of thrust and vortices.
limitation: Tethered vacuum supply likely required; tested in tank conditions only.
decision_relevance: Supports variable-stiffness gait switching in underwater robot design.

object: COF mixed matrix membranes for H2/CO2 separation
problem: How to make large-area asymmetrical COF mixed matrix membranes without interfacial defects?
mechanism_or_method: Non-solvent induced phase separation-triggered in situ interfacial polymerization forms ultrathin COF skin and dispersed COF nanocrystals in PES.
limitation: Centimeter-scale membranes; mixed-gas, humid and long-term stability not specified.

object: CNT-reinforced phase-change fibers for wearable thermoregulation
problem: How to reconcile energy storage density, mechanical robustness and phase-change stability in wearable phase-change fibers?
mechanism_or_method: 0.1 wt% CNT scaffold with interpenetrating polymer networks inducing heterogeneous nucleation and enhanced interfacial thermal coupling.
limitation: Lab fiber production; wash durability and wearer thermal comfort trials not reported.

object: Ta-free CoFeNi high entropy soft magnetic alloys
problem: Can Ta-free CoFeNi alloys be both magnetically soft and mechanically strong and ductile?
mechanism_or_method: Al and Ti additions with a processing pathway giving hierarchical multiphase precipitation.
limitation: Abstract gives little quantitative detail; motor-relevant high-frequency performance unclear.

object: ultrathin ionic thermoelectric cells for wearables
problem: How to retain ionic thermoelectric performance upon miniaturization using near-body heat?
mechanism_or_method: Asymmetric architecture coupling thermally driven ionic modulation at one interface with pseudocapacitive charge storage at the other.
limitation: Low open-circuit voltage per cell; long-term wear stability not stated.

problem: Can machine learning design a low-modulus biomedical Ti alloy suited to laser powder bed fusion?
mechanism_or_method: CALPHAD, machine learning and multi-objective optimisation select Ti-Nb-Ta-Zr-Sn, validated by laser powder bed fusion printing.
limitation: Only one alloy validated; fatigue and in vivo implant performance not shown.
decision_relevance: Supports alloy selection for printed low-stiffness orthopaedic implants.

object: layered architected materials with extreme nonlinearity
problem: How to program multistage snap-buckling and plateau responses in layered architected materials?
mechanism_or_method: Inverse design simultaneously optimizing local microstructures within layers and their interconnections, validated by simulation and hybrid fabrication.
limitation: Small-scale printed samples; rate effects and repeated snapping durability not described.
decision_relevance: Enables tailored energy-dissipation and vibration-control mechanical metamaterials.

problem: How do local structural distortions determine the magnetic molecular field in a high-entropy spinel oxide?
mechanism_or_method: EXAFS comparison with parent ACr2O4 compounds plus DFT over multiple configurations reveals suppressed Jahn-Teller distortion and bond distributions.
limitation: Single composition studied; synchrotron EXAFS required; magnetic conclusions rely on mean-field picture.

object: fluorinated polyimide membranes for hydrocarbon fractionation
problem: How to engineer membranes that fractionate liquid hydrocarbons by molecular size with less energy than distillation?
mechanism_or_method: Stoichiometry-controlled polycondensation tunes chain packing and microporosity, cast into asymmetric membranes for two-stage organic solvent reverse osmosis.
limitation: Model kerosene-paraffin mixture in toluene; real crude fractions and long-term stability untested.

problem: Can a programmable acoustically transparent metamaterial enable real-time high-resolution dynamic acoustic holograms?
mechanism_or_method: Crosslinked semi-crystalline polymer with erasable modulus patterns combined with partitioned piezoelectric transducer for wavefront modulation at 50000 fps.
limitation: Pattern rewrite takes about 13 minutes; tested in laboratory acoustic setups only.
